items.prompt: The BFS result has distance None for a vertex. Which interpretation matches the lesson?

options.text: It was discovered, but its shortest hop count is still pending
options.why: This BFS assigns the distance when a vertex is first enqueued; None means it was not reached, not a pending discovered state.

options.text: It has an automatically known zero-edge path from the source
options.why: Only the source has that empty-edge path.

options.text: It is unreachable from this source in the supplied graph

items.explanation: Keep unreachable separate from a legitimate zero distance; otherwise downstream path/reconciliation logic becomes false.
